ai_said: A Native VLAN mismatch is present on the trunk link between Switch-1 and Switch-2 on interface GigabitEthernet0/1. Switch-1 is configured to use VLAN 10 as its native VLAN, whereas Switch-2 is configured to use VLAN 99. This leads to configuration inconsistency, CDP warnings, and potential leakage of VLAN 10 management traffic.
correct_answer:
configure terminal
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
switchport trunk native vlan 99
